2760-4279-6559.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
2760-4279-6559.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Venerated Stormsinger triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
2760-4279-6559.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

1981-2415-2511-8175.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Edgar and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Edgar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

requires.n: Zombie Creature castable for one colored mana

728-3249-4289-7968--206.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-4289-7968--206.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the zombie castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the zombie castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that zombie spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that zombie or when it enters, Diregraf Colossus triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

728-5058-7422.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature that has Screams from Within attached.
When the creature dies, Screams from Within triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-3899-4506.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-3899-4506.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

38-2173-5220-7492.description:
Cast Skirk Prospector by paying its mana cost.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Mortuary and Arnyn trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Skirk Prospector from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Arnyn trigger, causing target opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Cast Skirk Prospector from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

198-1978-7329.description:
Animate Empowered Autogenerator using Mind Transfer Protocol.
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding one mana of any color for each charge counter on it.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat from step 2.
198-1978-7329.notes: You can reduce the mana cost by {1} if Empowered Autogenerator has any charge counters on it.

2933-4499-5798-7296.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Scions by tapping them, adding {2}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tapped Eldrazi Scion tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite {C}, and then forego tapping or sacrificing subsequent Eldrazi Scions.

372-4681-7193.description:
Cast Omni-Changeling by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
Put the original Abdel Adrian into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing Karmic Guide to return to the battlefield from exile.
Karmic Guide and Omni-Changeling's abilities trigger.
Resolve the Omni-Changeling ability, choosing to exile Karmic Guide until Omni-Changeling leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Omni-Changeling into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing Karmic Guide to return to the battlefield from exile.
Karmic Guide and Abdel Adrian's abilities trigger.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian ability, exiling Karmic Guide until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Omni-Changeling from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 2.

2440-3480-3581-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Spirit you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Spirit token.
Activate the Spirit token by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature a returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
2440-3480-3581-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced to as little as {1} if you control other Spirits. You can also sacrifice the Spirits once you have enough to get infinite {R}.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

5434-5555-5686-6922.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is at least 2.
5434-5555-5686-6922.notablePrerequisites: You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
5434-5555-5686-6922.description:
Activate Coveted Falcon by paying {1}{U}, turning it face up.
Coveted Falcon triggers, causing an opponent to gain control of Karlov Watchdog and causing you to draw a card.
During the opponent's turn, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-3292-3892-5295.description:
Cast Spear Spewer by paying {R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Activate Spear Spewer by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each player.
Dissipation Field triggers, returning Spear Spewer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
392-3292-3892-5295.notes: It is recommended to perform this combo when you have more life than your opponents to end the game, but it is not required. If this combo will not end the game, stop once you have 1 life.

1479-5700-5701-6529-6763.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-5700-5701-6529-6763.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Curse of the Restless Dead trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Curse of the Restless Dead trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Curse of the Restless Dead triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Curse of the Restless Dead trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Curse of the Restless Dead triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

360-1981-4416-6740.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 3.
You control two untapped Soldiers.
360-1981-4416-6740.description:
Declare Phyrexian Vindicator as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate Catapult Squad by tapping two Soldiers, attempting to deal 2 damage to Phyrexian Vindicator.
The damage is prevented due to Phyrexian Vindicator's replacement effect. Phyrexian Vindicator triggers, dealing 2 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating two 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
When the Soldiers enter the battlefield, Soul Warden triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

2292-4550-5042-5567--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
2292-4550-5042-5567--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

224-1046-2248.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {G}.
224-1046-2248.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Living Twister's second ability by paying {G}, returning the land from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Skyshroud Ranger by tapping it, putting the land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Skyshroud Ranger.
Repeat.

1115-3204-4251-4364.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Aurelia.
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Aurelia or Godo must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
1115-3204-4251-4364.description:
Declare either Aurelia or Godo and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Aurelia or Godo trigger.
Resolve the Aurelia or Godo trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Aurelia or Godo from the battlefield, and then returning Aurelia or Godo from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

222-527-2034-4359.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

277-1170-1770-2733-5954.description:
Cast Shimmering Wings by paying {U}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Tiller Engine triggers, untapping them.
Resolve the Shimmering Wings spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Shimmering Wings by paying {U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

967-5147-5173-5258-5618.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Shambling Ghast from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, exiling Shambling Ghast from the top of your library with the ability to cast it until your next turn.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Shambling Ghast from exile by paying {1}.
Prosper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

969-3372-5231-6006.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if Enduring Vitality is not a creature
969-3372-5231-6006.description:
If Enduring Vitality is not a creature, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Enduring Vitality to become a creature.
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Enduring Vitality, adding {R}.
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Kaslem, Deepest Growth // Temple of Cultivation

654-2034-2757-5552.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least ten permanents.
You control a basic Forest.
654-2034-2757-5552.description:
Activate a basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Ojer Kaslem, untapping the Forest.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ojer Kaslem, adding {C}{C}.
When Ojer Kaslem dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as Temple of Cultivation.
When Temple of Cultivation enters the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping Temple of Cultivation.
Activate Temple of Cultivation's second ability by paying {2}{G} and tapping it, transforming Temple of Cultivation into Ojer Kaslem.
Repeat.

2060-2558-3490-3910-4017.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional artifact.
2060-2558-3490-3910-4017.description:
Activate Breya by paying {2} and sacrificing Sword of the Meek and another artifact, causing you to gain 5 life.
Sunbond triggers, putting five +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Animation Module triggers, holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Servo.
Repeat.

4843-5342.notablePrerequisites: Virtus the Veiled does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
4843-5342.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Virtus the Veiled.
Virtus the Veiled triggers, causing the defending opponent to lose their entire life total due to Bloodletter of Aclazotz.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

3341-4872.notablePrerequisites: Charnelhoard Wurm does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
3341-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Charnelhoard Wurm.
Charnelhoard Wurm triggers, returning Time Warp to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat each turn.

703-2500-2743.description:
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two token copies of Mirage Mirror that are 3/3 Dragons in addition to their other types.
Activate the three Mirage Mirrors by paying {6}, causing each of them to become a copy of Biovisionary until end of turn.
At the beginning of your end step, Biovisionary and each Mirage Mirror trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

1684-2034-2178-3263.notablePrerequisites: Thornbite Staff attached to Rakka Mar.
1684-2034-2178-3263.description:
Activate Rakka Mar by paying {1} and tapping it to create an Elemental token with haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Elemental token, adding {C}{C}.
Rakka Mar triggers, untapping.
Repeat.
